surface.basis: Pirelli 2025 Azerbaijan GP preview: asphalt grip 2/5, asphalt abrasion 1/5. Other ratings, not used here: traction 5, braking 4, lateral 1, tyre stress 3, track evolution 5, downforce 2.

source.notes: Projected, rotated to start on a straight, scaled to 6,003 m; widths by section from OpenStreetMap (ODbL), 7.6 m at the castle, walled at the kerb. Heights: SRTM 30 m (public domain) through Open Topo Data, sampled every 20 m along az-2016 from bacinger/f1-circuits, lined up by curvature and smoothed over about 200 m.
